$ llm.py --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py [-h] {run,exec,project,agent,lint,health} ...

positional arguments:
  {run,exec,project,agent,lint,health}
    exec                長駐串流 session:照宣告組旗標後 exec 成 claude(stdin/stdout 是 stream-json)
    project             專案自己宣告的模型呼叫(由 cap-runner 執行)
    agent               專案自己宣告的 agent 呼叫(由 cap-runner 執行)
    health              brunna.json llm 的每一家 provider 能不能用(key、連線、模型在不在)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
--- stderr

$ llm.py run --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py run [-h] [--cwd CWD] [--model MODEL] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] [--dry-run]
                  point [extra ...]

positional arguments:
  point
  extra                 額外的 claude 參數(放在 -- 後面)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD
  --model MODEL
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --dry-run             只印出會執行的指令,不呼叫模型
--- stderr

$ llm.py exec --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py exec [-h] [--cwd CWD] [--model MODEL] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] point [extra ...]

positional arguments:
  point
  extra

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD
  --model MODEL
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
--- stderr

$ llm.py run nosuch    # unknown point
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
llm.py:nosuch 不是宣告過的判斷點(contracts/llm-points.yaml)

$ llm.py exec reflect-week    # exec without stream
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr

$ llm.py exec lease-session    # runtime without stream

--- stderr
